description: [stores] Delete memory entries matching filters. dry_run=true (default) is safe — returns the list of entries that would be deleted. Pinned entries are never forgotten. At least one filter required. Owner only — registered handle + secret required.

dry_run.description: if true, return candidates without deleting

not_read_in_days.description: delete entries not read in N days

older_than_days.description: delete entries last updated > N days ago

name: forget_memories
